editorial_note: Root's first manual reinvention. A 1990s GeoCities-era homepage built on the divshot/geo-bootstrap theme — marquee tags, rainbow text, banana GIF dividers, M.C. Hammer crossing animations, Under Construction signs, hit counter. Demonstrated that the firm was willing to ship something genuinely silly while still being legibly Root.
